snippet.title: Day 8, Not Day 10 🐌 Riddle #12 Answer + Riddle #13: Two Ropes, Exactly 45 Minutes 🔥 #shorts
snippet.description:
Yesterday's mystery: a snail in a 10-metre well climbs up 3 metres every day and slides back down 2 metres every night.

ANSWER: DAY 8. Each full day and night the snail gains only 1 metre, so after 7 days and 7 nights it is at 7 metres. On day 8 it climbs 3 more metres, reaches 10 metres and is out before night. Not day 10!

RIDDLE #13: Person 1 has two ropes and a lighter. Each rope takes exactly one hour to burn, but they burn unevenly: fast in some parts, slow in others. There is no clock, no phone and no ruler. How can Person 1 measure exactly 45 minutes?

Comment your answer 👇 The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.

#riddle #puzzle #brainteaser #logic #mystery #solvebysunrise #shorts
